id: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem (2023)

facts.text: Pizza is the best, dudes. Share it with your brothers, or at least save me the crust.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Michelangelo's real pizza line is 'Can we explain this over some pizza?'.
facts.fix: Can we explain this over some pizza?

fix_note.text: Can we explain this over some pizza?

facts.text: Grabbed on the grocery run, Splinter none the wiser.
facts.why: Splinter catches the turtles sneaking back in late and asks where they were. They tell him they were shopping, then admit some wanted to see a movie.
facts.fix: Grabbed on the Go-Gurt run. Splinter caught them sneaking back.

facts.text: Serve the mains when the turtles head up to the rooftops with pizza.
facts.why: The turtles are on a rooftop for the watermelon scene, but they never head up with pizza. Mikey does ask April if they can explain things over some pizza.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Mikey offers to explain everything over some pizza.

vibe.verdict: The sewer takeaway with fortune slip and delivery run chat now reads like the film, with Ratatouille, the watermelon and Super Duper Fly all printing.
ideas: Swap 'Turtle shell guacamole' for 'Go-Gurt mission yoghurt tubes'.
Swap 'Kiwi lime slushie' note for 'Mikey's watermelon head'.
Swap 'Chinatown pork and chive dumplings' note for 'Movie night, no humans needed'.
Rename 'Superfly's loaded supreme pizza' to 'Super Duper Fly supreme'.
